annotation_quality: provisional single-AI visual audit; not expert ground truth

protocol.purpose: Evaluate categorical trait recognition, never species classification
protocol.sample: all 39 frozen small-run-v1 test observations; no prediction-based selection
protocol.annotation: AI visual review; not expert-validated gold
protocol.blinding: random audit IDs; no species names, flora traits or model predictions in annotation packet
protocol.visibility: Score outline only when enough diagnostic shape is visible; withhold if severe cropping, folding, occlusion, conflicting leaves or blur prevents a defensible label. Hair absence requires a well-resolved surface; no visible hairs in an unresolved image is unknown.
protocol.test_policy: Freeze image annotations before scoring checkpoints; no retraining or selection on audit results
protocol.ambiguous_labels: Retain multiple plausible outline labels, score set-compatible top-1 separately; per-class precision/recall use only single-label images. Never collapse uncertainty to a negative.
protocol.hairiness_target: Broad hairy phenotype (hairy, pubescent, tomentose descendant union) versus glabrous; exact hair subtypes not assigned without resolved evidence.
protocol.blinding_limit: Image packets conceal identifiers, profiles and predictions; reviewer retains prior study context. This is not an independently blinded expert benchmark.
protocol.external_sample: All 17 fixed UCI leaf-control test specimens; categorical annotations newly reviewed from images, not UCI-provided gold labels. Existing numeric traits and species labels were not shown during annotation.
protocol.external_views: Score both original and precomputed masked BioCLIP features; neither selected using this audit.
protocol.hair_metrics_policy: If only positive or only negative assessable examples exist, report corresponding detection rate but withhold precision/F1/AUROC claims of discrimination.

hairiness.limitation: Both positive and negative assessable examples are needed for discrimination metrics.
